subject: Memorial Garden Dedication for Seven Educators
overview: The Medford community dedicated memorial gardens at Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School to honor seven educators lost during the COVID-19 pandemic. The ceremony featured personal tributes from colleagues, poetry readings, and recognition of the collaborative student-led effort to build the reflective spaces.

items.title: Opening and Moment of Silence
items.summary: Michael Skorker welcomed guests and led a moment of silence for Lisa Iannelli, Frank D'Alessio, Sue Bratton, Betsy Burns, Dennis Moriarty, Anne Glencross, and Kevin Hickey.

items.title: School Administration Remarks
items.summary: Principals Paul D'Alleva and Chad Fallon thanked the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility (CCSR) and vocational students for designing and building the memorial spaces.

items.title: Garden Purpose and Student Poetry
items.summary: Michael Skorker detailed the 13-month project to create native pollinator gardens for community healing, followed by student Matteo D'Aveta reading an original poem.

items.title: Personal Tributes to Educators
items.summary: Colleagues and family members shared personal stories, voicemails, and poems to memorialize the specific contributions and characters of the seven deceased staff members.

items.title: District and City Acknowledgments
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent, CCSR Director Richard Trotta, and Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn offered condolences and pledged permanent funding for the gardens' upkeep.
